subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw support MiniMax Token Plan SKILL bundles in native sub-agents by changing the bootstrap or skill-inheritance boundary, or should those workflows stay on explicit plugin, skill, or ClawHub surfaces while only confirmed provider bugs are fixed?
rationale: The source evidence shows an intentional endpoint contract and an intentional sub-agent context boundary, while the reported Token Plan behavior still lacks live API proof; changing either requires maintainer product direction rather than an automatic repair.

options.title: Fix provider only after live proof
options.body: Keep the AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md sub-agent boundary and make only a narrow MiniMax provider or media-completion fix if live Token Plan evidence proves current routing is wrong.

options.title: Add explicit sub-agent skill inheritance
options.body: Define a new opt-in allowlist or contract for selected Token Plan skills to be visible in sub-agents, with docs and tests for the security/context boundary.

options.title: Route office bundles outside core
options.body: Treat PPT, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF generation as external mmx or ClawHub skill/plugin workflows unless a missing OpenClaw extension API is proven.

recommendation.title: Fix provider only after live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md sub-agent boundary and make only a narrow MiniMax provider or media-completion fix if live Token Plan evidence proves current routing is wrong.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline routed maintainer attention to steipete, and the decision is about product boundary rather than one file's implementation.
